name: my-cv
description: Single source of truth (resume.json + brand.json) -> site / PDF / DOCX / MD / TXT

scripts.validate:data: npm run build:shared && npm run validate-data -w @my-cv/shared
scripts.build:pdf: npm run build -w @my-cv/pdf-renderer && npm run render -w @my-cv/pdf-renderer
scripts.build:docx: npm run build -w @my-cv/docx-renderer && npm run render -w @my-cv/docx-renderer
scripts.build:md: npm run build -w @my-cv/md-renderer && npm run render -w @my-cv/md-renderer
scripts.build:txt: npm run build -w @my-cv/txt-renderer && npm run render -w @my-cv/txt-renderer
scripts.build:all: npm run validate:data && npm run build:md && npm run build:txt && npm run build:docx && npm run build:site && npm run build:pdf
